item.title: Golang Microservices: Coming from a Monolith
item.description:
Golang Microservices: Coming from a Monolith

课程链接 : 7-Coming from a Monolith

In the real world, 99% of use cases you won't create a project from scratch as microservices.

Most of the times you can fix your problems, your scale, scalabitlity issues by just scaling.

Yon don't win by having Microservices.

The two best reasons to choose MS is because:

  • Your organization is growing and needs to allow for more developers to work, without getting in each other way.
  • Improved Scalability and Resilience.

In short, Monolith is enough.
